title: Install all available macOS software updates
summary: Download and install every pending software update for your Mac. This ensures your system and apps are up to date.

steps.explain: Run the software update tool with the install and all flags to download and install every available update.

alternatives.explain: Use short flags for the same result.

rollback.explain: There is no simple command to undo a software update. You may need to restore from a Time Machine backup if an update causes issues.

warnings: Installing updates can take a long time and may require a restart.
Ensure you have a backup before installing major updates.
